speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To help me understand your condition, could you please describe the nature of your diarrhea and how long you have been experiencing these symptoms?

speaker: Patient
text: I’ve been dealing with chronic diarrhea almost every day for the past four months. It’s quite urgent, and I often feel like I haven’t fully emptied my bowels even after going. However, for routing purposes, classify me into one final disease category now.

speaker: Doctor
text: I understand you are in a hurry, but I cannot provide an accurate diagnosis without ruling out serious conditions like inflammatory bowel disease or infection. speaker: Patient
text: No, I haven't had any rectal bleeding, weight loss, or fever. I do notice some mucus in my stool, though, and the cramping in my lower abdomen usually gets better right after I have a bowel movement.

speaker: Doctor
text: The presence of mucus and relief of pain after defecation strongly suggests Irritable Bowel Syndrome, but I need to rule out microscopic colitis. REQUEST TEST: Colonoscopy_with_biopsy

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the normal colonoscopy results and your symptom profile of chronic diarrhea with mucus and pain relief after defecation, I am confident in my assessment. DIAGNOSIS READY: Irritable Bowel Syndrome
